# UA Alert Map

> UA Alert Map is a Ukrainian-language interactive online simulator of air-raid alerts and threat notifications in Ukraine.

Canonical URL: https://dacukpavlo.github.io/ukraine-alert-simulator/

## Main topics
- карта тривог України
- симулятор тривоги України
- онлайн карта тривог
- симулятор карти тривог
- повітряна тривога
- дронова загроза
- ракетна загроза

## What the site does
Users can search for a city, district or region in Ukraine, choose a threat type, and simulate alert highlighting and sounds. The site is a simulator and is not an official emergency alert service.

## Language
Primary language: Ukrainian (uk)

## Important
This is a public simulation website, not an official government warning system.
